title: Get Recipe from Dagmar Fitz

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: Order something or keep walking.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Order something or keep walking.

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: You haven't bought anything. So you're not a customer.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You haven't bought anything. So you're not a customer.

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: "Hello".

pronounText.TextHeVersion: "Hello".

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: Felicitations.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Felicitations.

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: You're giving me a migraine.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're giving me a migraine.

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: Calling it a job is like calling a trip to the dentist a vacation.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Calling it a job is like calling a trip to the dentist a vacation.

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: Oh alright, fine.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh alright, fine.

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: Yeah, the specialty of the house. It's called "Go Fuck Yourself" Pie. Now get out of my face.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, the specialty of the house. It's called "Go Fuck Yourself" Pie. Now get out of my face.

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: And I'm just trying to get through the day without stabbing someone.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And I'm just trying to get through the day without stabbing someone.

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: Why are you shilling for recipes anyhow?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why are you shilling for recipes anyhow?

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: Thaddeus's place? Ha, and I thought I was in trouble. Fuck it, I'll give you some recipe tips if you want them.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thaddeus's place? Ha, and I thought I was in trouble. Fuck it, I'll give you some recipe tips if you want them.

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: No, you didn't. And I don't appreciate the smell of bullshit.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, you didn't. And I don't appreciate the smell of bullshit.

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: Yeah, if only to piss off CorpSec. It'll be my good deed for the decade.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, if only to piss off CorpSec. It'll be my good deed for the decade.

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: Unfortunately I'm addicted to this substance called "food".

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Unfortunately I'm addicted to this substance called "food".

nodes.speaker: Dagmar Fitz
nodes.text: Look, if I give you some tips will you leave?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, if I give you some tips will you leave?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Wow. Nice customer service.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wow. Nice customer service.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm new here. Came to say hello.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm new here. Came to say hello.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm new here. Came to say hello.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm new here. Came to say hello.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I've taken over the Noodle Bar.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I've taken over the Noodle Bar.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I've taken over the Noodle Bar.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I've taken over the Noodle Bar.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Right. I'm your competition.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right. I'm your competition.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's a tough job, huh?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's a tough job, huh?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So why do you do it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So why do you do it?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So why do you do it?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So why do you do it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll go if you give me one of your recipes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll go if you give me one of your recipes.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'll go if you give me one of your recipes.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'll go if you give me one of your recipes.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm sorry. I'm just trying to find recipes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm sorry. I'm just trying to find recipes.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm sorry. I'm just trying to find recipes.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm sorry. I'm just trying to find recipes.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You'll give me a recipe?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You'll give me a recipe?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sorry to bother you. I'll go.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sorry to bother you. I'll go.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sorry to bother you. I'll go.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sorry to bother you. I'll go.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I just inherited a failing business with only one dish on the menu.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I just inherited a failing business with only one dish on the menu.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I just inherited a failing business with only one dish on the menu.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I just inherited a failing business with only one dish on the menu.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Heard your place was the best in the district.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Heard your place was the best in the district.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Heard your place was the best in the district.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Heard your place was the best in the district.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You will?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You will?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thanks, appreciate it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks, appreciate it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What a drag.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What a drag.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll get my tiny violin.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll get my tiny violin.
